opening.argument: The presentation is centered on practical IBM recruitment and test-preparation guidance. It states that it will cover “everything you need to know about their written test pattern, their most important topics and their interview process,” then addresses quantitative aptitude and provides interview guidance and stated hiring timelines. It also promotes online classes, subscriptions, social media, and discount coupons, including “discount coupons valid only for our youtube viewers for both online classes and smart material subscription.” The attributed “84 percent” placement figure is unsupported, but the described material shows no required payment, credential request, guaranteed selection, or other deceptive mechanism. Its dominant function remains educational and operational: explaining recruitment topics and preparation while separately advertising optional offerings.
